claims.text: The issue arises because the `make_bytes` function in `django/http/response.py` only explicitly handles instances of `bytes` and `str`. When a `memoryview` object is passed, it fails the `isinstance(value, bytes)` check at line 232 and the `isinstance(value, str)` check at line 234. Consequently, the code falls through to the default behavior which calls `str(value).encode()`, converting the memoryview object into its string representation (e.g., '<memory at 0x...>') instead of extracting the underlying bytes.

predicted_mechanism: Memoryview is neither bytes nor str and falls through to str(value).encode
